outline:
This course aims to explain the fundamental of machine learning, including the concept and algorithms, and applications in industry. The main contents include:
1. Fundamental of Machine Learning
2. Learning Theory
3. Machine Learning Algorithms
4. Neural network and Backpropagation
5. Deep learning models
6. Term project and hands-on labs

Week 1: Introduction to Machine Learning
Week 2: Holiday
Weel 3: Machine Learning & Linear Models
Week 4: Learning Theory
Week 5: Learning Theory
Week 6: Neural Network and Backpropagation
Week 7: Holiday
Week 8: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
Week 9: Case and Paper Presentation
Week 10: Training Neural Network
Week 11: Training Neural Network
Week 12: CNN Architectures
Week 13: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)
Week 14: Autoencoder & Generative Models
Week 15: Hands-on Labs
Week 16: Hands-on Labs
Week 17: Holiday
Week 18: Presentation of Final Term Project
assessment:

•	Hands-on Lab (20%)
•	Paper presentation (20%)
•	Final Term Project (40%)
